signup.title: Create account
signup.subtitle: Enter your email — we'll send a code to confirm registration.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.subtitle: Enter your email or phone — we'll send a code to sign in.

confirm.title: Confirmation

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to your email. Enter it to continue.
hint.PHONE: We sent a code to your phone. Enter it to continue.
hint.TOTP: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

confirm.awaitingFinish: The code was accepted, but signing in failed. No need to confirm again — just try once more.
confirm.lastResend: Note: that was the last resend of the code.
confirm.exhaustedAttempts: Wrong code, no attempts left. Request a new code.
confirm.exhaustedExpired: The code has expired. Request a new code.
confirm.deadEnd: You've run out of entry attempts and resends. Start signing in again.
confirm.invalidated: This operation can no longer be completed. Start signing in again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.tzUnsupported: your browser does not know this zone, dates are shown in the device time zone

settings.title: Settings
settings.langHint: Language of emails and server messages. The interface language is switched in the header.
settings.osZoneHint: Your zone is {{zone}}; it is not in the list. Pick “Auto” and the server will choose the closest one.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Information shown may differ from them for a while — to apply them instantly, sign in again.
settings.substituted: The closest available zone was saved: {{zone}} — its time differs from yours.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.terminateAll: Terminate all sessions in this workspace
sessions.confirmText: All listed sessions on other devices ({{n}}) will be closed.
sessions.noRealms: You don't belong to any workspace — nothing to show.
sessions.closeError: Could not close the sessions. Please try again.

errors.signup: Sign up failed. Please try again later.
